title: Change AF-area mode (incl. 3D tracking)

steps.text: Hold the AF-mode button (center of the focus-mode switch)
Spin the front dial: single-point → dynamic 9/21/51 → 3D → auto
For animals: AF-C + 3D tracking — lock the point on the eye, let it follow

tip: Single-point for precision, dynamic-21 for erratic movers, 3D when the subject crosses the frame.
